source.check: votes read from the result report; 1,482 + 226 + 9 = 1,717 (42 per cent of 4,130)

note: Triennial election of Antrim County Council on the 23 county electoral divisions; nominations received on 17 May 1949, withdrawals to 18 May, and polling on Thursday 2 June 1949 ('POLLING took place yesterday', Belfast News-Letter, 3 June 1949, p. 5). Two divisions were contested, Portrush and Ballycastle; the other 21 members were returned unopposed. No party labels were printed. Seat vacated by Captain Hugh Lecky, who did not seek re-election.
